title: How to reach
description: Fly into Kilimanjaro International (JRO), then about four hours by road through Arusha and Karatu to the crater rim.

title: What to prepare
description: Warm layers for the rim at dawn, binoculars, a hat and sunscreen. The descent road opens early; be ready to leave before sunrise.

title: Best time to visit
description: June to October is the dry season, when animals gather near water and the roads are easiest.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Istanbul Airport (IST); the drive to Sultanahmet takes about 45-60 minutes, depending on traffic. Sabiha Gökçen Airport (SAW), on the Asian side, is around an hour away. From Pakistan, non-stop flights run from Karachi, Lahore and Islamabad.

title: What to prepare
description: Buy entry tickets online to shorten the queue. Dress modestly: shoulders and knees covered, and women should bring a scarf to cover their hair. Visits pause during prayer times, so allow some flexibility.

title: Best time to visit
description: November to April is quieter. Arrive early in the morning, or visit in late afternoon when the western light fills the galleries. Avoid Friday midday prayers.

title: Make it special
description: Book a private historian-guide who can read the mosaics and inscriptions with you, then continue to the Basilica Cistern across the square.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Istanbul Airport (IST); allow 45-60 minutes by car to Sultanahmet. The palace gate is beside Hagia Sophia, and the T1 tram stops nearby. From Pakistan, non-stop flights run from Karachi, Lahore and Islamabad.

title: What to prepare
description: Book tickets online and decide in advance whether to add the Harem. Wear comfortable shoes for cobbles and many steps. Modest dress is expected in the Sacred Relics chamber.

title: Best time to visit
description: Spring (April-May) and autumn (September-October) are the most comfortable. Arrive at opening to see the Treasury before tour groups. The palace closes one day a week, so check before you go.

title: Make it special
description: Take a private guide for the Harem, then continue by private boat along the Bosphorus at sunset, past the palaces and waterfront mansions.

title: How to reach
description: Fly to Istanbul, then take a domestic flight to Nevşehir Kapadokya (NAV), about 40 minutes by car from Göreme, or Kayseri (ASR), about 1 hour 15 minutes away. From Pakistan, non-stop flights run from Karachi, Lahore and Islamabad to Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Book a balloon flight well ahead with a licensed operator, and plan two mornings in case the first is cancelled for wind. Bring warm layers for pre-dawn starts, even in summer, and sturdy shoes for the valley trails.

title: Best time to visit
description: April to June and September to October bring mild days and the steadiest flying weather. Balloons launch around sunrise; the valleys are loveliest in the low light of late afternoon.

title: Make it special
description: Reserve a private balloon basket, then hike the Rose Valley with a guide and finish with dinner on a cave-hotel terrace.

title: How to reach
description: Fly to Denizli Çardak (DNZ) via Istanbul; the drive to Pamukkale takes about an hour. From Selçuk and Ephesus it is roughly three hours by road. From Pakistan, non-stop flights run from Karachi, Lahore and Islamabad to Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Shoes come off on the travertines, so bring a bag to carry them and a towel for your feet. Bring swimwear for the Antique Pool, sunscreen and a hat, as there is little shade.

title: Best time to visit
description: April to June and September to October are the most comfortable. Come early in the morning, or stay for sunset, when the terraces glow and the day visitors leave.

title: How to reach
description: Fly to İzmir Adnan Menderes (ADB) via Istanbul, then drive about an hour to Selçuk. The site has an upper and a lower gate, 4 km from town. From Pakistan, non-stop flights run from Karachi, Lahore and Islamabad to Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Buy tickets in advance and include the Terrace Houses. Wear good walking shoes for uneven marble, and bring water, a hat and sunscreen. Enter at the upper gate and walk downhill.

title: Best time to visit
description: April-May and September-October are ideal. Arrive at opening, before cruise groups from Kuşadası, or come in late afternoon when the light warms the library façade.

title: Make it special
description: Walk the site with a private archaeologist-guide, then lunch among the vineyards of Şirince village.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Dubai International (DXB); Downtown is about 20 minutes by car, or take the Metro Red Line to Burj Khalifa/Dubai Mall station. From Pakistan, non-stop flights run from Karachi, Lahore and Islamabad.

title: What to prepare
description: Book a timed ticket in advance, particularly for sunset slots, which sell out. Entry is through The Dubai Mall, so allow time to walk. Bring sunglasses; the glare can be strong on clear days.

title: Best time to visit
description: November to March brings the clearest air and mild evenings. Choose the hour before sunset to see the city by day and at night in one visit. Summer haze can soften the view.

title: Make it special
description: Reserve the level 148 lounge at sunset, then dine at a restaurant high in the tower with the fountain lit below.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Dubai International (DXB); Al Fahidi is about 15 minutes by car. The Metro Green Line serves Al Fahidi station. From Pakistan, non-stop flights run from Karachi, Lahore and Islamabad.

title: What to prepare
description: Carry small cash for abra fares and souk purchases. Dress modestly, with shoulders and knees covered. Comfortable, flat shoes suit the narrow lanes.

title: Best time to visit
description: November to March is pleasant for walking. Go in late afternoon, cross the creek at sunset, and explore the souks as they come alive in the evening.

title: Make it special
description: Hire a private abra for an hour on the creek, then join a cultural lunch of Emirati dishes in a restored courtyard house.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Dubai International (DXB); the reserve is about 45-60 minutes by car on the Dubai-Al Ain road. Operators collect guests from city hotels. From Pakistan, non-stop flights run from Karachi, Lahore and Islamabad.

title: What to prepare
description: Book with an operator licensed for the reserve. Wear loose, covering clothes, a hat and closed shoes, and bring a warm layer for winter evenings. Sunglasses help against the glare.

title: Best time to visit
description: October to April is the season. Go at dawn for balloon flights and wildlife, or late afternoon for sunset over the dunes. Summer heat is intense.

title: Make it special
description: Take a sunrise balloon flight, then a falconry breakfast in the dunes, and end the day with a private dinner at a desert camp.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Abu Dhabi's Zayed International Airport (AUH), about 20 minutes by car. From Dubai the drive takes around 1 hour 30 minutes. From Pakistan, non-stop flights run from Karachi, Lahore and Islamabad.

title: What to prepare
description: Register for a free visitor pass online before you go. Dress modestly: long, loose clothing for everyone, and women must cover their hair. Shoes are removed before entering the prayer hall.

title: Best time to visit
description: November to March is most comfortable. Arrive an hour before sunset to see the marble change colour and stay for the lighting. The mosque closes to visitors during Friday prayers.

title: Good to know
description: Free guided tours explain the architecture and Islamic practice. Photography is welcome in most areas, but be respectful of worshippers.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Abu Dhabi's Zayed International Airport (AUH); Saadiyat Island is about 25 minutes by car. From Dubai allow around 1 hour 30 minutes. From Pakistan, non-stop flights run from Karachi, Lahore and Islamabad.

title: What to prepare
description: Book timed tickets online, especially at weekends. Galleries are cool, so bring a light layer. Comfortable shoes help, as the museum spreads across many rooms.

title: Best time to visit
description: October to April is ideal. Visit in the late afternoon, when the light under the dome is at its most beautiful, and stay for the evening.

title: Make it special
description: Join a guided kayak trip around the museum's sea walls at sunset, or book a private curator-led tour.

title: How to reach
description: Fly to AlUla International (ULH) via Riyadh or Jeddah; the drive to Hegra takes about 45-60 minutes. Non-stop flights run from Karachi, Lahore and Islamabad to Riyadh and Jeddah, with a domestic connection to AlUla.

title: What to prepare
description: Tours must be booked in advance through the official AlUla channels. Wear modest, loose clothing, a hat and closed shoes. Nights in winter can be cold, so bring a warm layer.

title: Best time to visit
description: October to March is the season, with warm days and cool nights. Book a morning or late-afternoon tour for softer light on the façades.

title: Make it special
description: Book a private guided tour in a vintage Land Rover, then watch sunset from the desert and dine under the stars.

title: How to reach
description: Fly to AlUla International (ULH) via Riyadh or Jeddah, then drive about 30-40 minutes. Non-stop flights run from Karachi, Lahore and Islamabad to Riyadh and Jeddah, with a domestic connection to AlUla.

title: What to prepare
description: No ticket is usually needed, but check seasonal arrangements. Bring a warm layer for evenings in winter and wear modest clothing. Closed shoes are better than sandals on the sand.

title: Best time to visit
description: October to March. Arrive an hour before sunset and stay after dark, when the sky is clear and the rock is lit.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into King Khalid International (RUH); Diriyah is about 40 minutes by car. From Pakistan, non-stop flights run from Karachi, Lahore and Islamabad.

title: What to prepare
description: Book entry tickets online in advance. Wear modest, loose clothing and comfortable shoes. Bring water and sunglasses; paths are sunny.

title: Best time to visit
description: November to February is most comfortable. Go in late afternoon, stay for sunset and see the walls lit at night, then dine at Bujairi Terrace.

title: Make it special
description: Book a private historian-guide, then reserve a terrace table at Bujairi overlooking the illuminated citadel.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into King Khalid International (RUH). The site lies around 100 km north-west of Riyadh, about 2 hours by car, the last part on an off-road track that needs a 4x4. From Pakistan, non-stop flights run from Karachi, Lahore and Islamabad.

title: What to prepare
description: Go with a licensed operator and an experienced driver. Bring water, snacks, a hat, sturdy shoes and a warm layer for after sunset. Access can close after rain or in extreme heat.

title: Best time to visit
description: November to March. Leave Riyadh in early afternoon to arrive for the golden hour and sunset.

title: Make it special
description: Arrange a private 4x4 excursion with a sunset picnic and dinner set up on the rim.

title: How to reach
description: Fly to Red Sea International (RSI) on a domestic flight from Riyadh or Jeddah. Resorts arrange onward transfers by road, boat or seaplane. Non-stop flights run from Karachi, Lahore and Islamabad to Riyadh and Jeddah.

title: What to prepare
description: Book resorts and transfers together in advance. Pack reef-safe sunscreen, a sun hat and light cover-ups. Modest dress is expected away from resort beaches.

title: Best time to visit
description: October to April offers warm water and pleasant air; summer is very hot. Snorkel in the morning when the sea is calmest.

title: Make it special
description: Charter a private boat to a sandbank for a picnic, with a dive guide to take you to the outer reefs.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Kuala Lumpur International (KUL). The KLIA Ekspres train reaches KL Sentral in about 30 minutes, then it is a short taxi ride; by car the trip takes about an hour. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Book Skybridge and observation deck tickets in advance, as daily numbers are limited. Carry an umbrella for sudden afternoon storms. Security screening applies, so travel light.

title: Best time to visit
description: The weather is warm all year, with heavier rain in the inter-monsoon months. Book the first tour of the morning for clear air, then return to KLCC Park at dusk for the lights.

title: Make it special
description: Book a suite facing the towers, and have dinner at a rooftop restaurant with a direct view of them lit up.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Kuala Lumpur International (KUL). From central Kuala Lumpur, Batu Caves is about 30 minutes by car, or take the KTM Komuter train from KL Sentral to Batu Caves station. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Cover shoulders and knees; sarongs can be borrowed or rented at the base. Wear good shoes for the steep steps. Keep food and loose items out of sight of the monkeys.

title: Best time to visit
description: Come early in the morning to avoid heat and crowds. Visit during Thaipusam for the festival, but expect very large crowds.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Langkawi International (LGK), usually via Kuala Lumpur; Kilim jetty is about 30-40 minutes by car. Ferries also link Langkawi with Penang and the mainland. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Book a licensed nature guide rather than a fast boat tour. Bring insect repellent, a hat, sunscreen and a light waterproof. Shoes that can get wet are useful for kayaking.

title: Best time to visit
description: November to April is the drier season, with calmer seas. Go in the morning when wildlife is most active and the light is soft.

title: Make it special
description: Charter a private boat with a naturalist, then continue to the open sea for a swim at a quiet beach.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Penang International (PEN), about 30-40 minutes by car from George Town. From Kuala Lumpur the drive takes about 4 hours. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Wear light clothes and comfortable shoes, and carry an umbrella for sun and rain. Remove shoes and dress modestly in temples and mosques. Carry cash for hawker stalls.

title: Best time to visit
description: December to February is usually drier. Explore on foot in the morning and early evening, and eat at hawker centres after dark.

title: Make it special
description: Take a private heritage walk with a local architect, then book a Nyonya dinner in a restored shophouse.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Kuala Lumpur International (KUL), then drive about 3-4 hours to Tanah Rata, the last stretch on winding hill roads. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Pack a warm layer and a light rain jacket; evenings are cool. Wear walking shoes with good grip for muddy trails. If you get travel sick, bring something for the hill road.

title: Best time to visit
description: January to March is usually the driest period; October and November are the wettest. Mornings are clearest before cloud rolls in, so visit the tea estates early.

title: Make it special
description: Take a guided walk through the tea gardens followed by a private tea tasting overlooking the estate.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Suvarnabhumi Airport (BKK), 45-60 minutes by car to the old city depending on traffic. From riverside hotels, take a boat to Tha Chang pier, next to the palace. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: The dress code is strict: covered shoulders, long trousers or long skirts, and no sheer clothing. Remove shoes inside temple halls. Bring water and a hat, as there is little shade.

title: Best time to visit
description: November to February is cooler and drier. Arrive at opening to avoid crowds and midday heat.

title: Make it special
description: Book a private guide and arrive by private river boat, then take lunch on a riverside terrace.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Suvarnabhumi Airport (BKK), 45-60 minutes by car to the old city. By boat, stop at Tha Tien pier, a short walk from the temple. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Cover shoulders and knees, and wear shoes that are easy to remove. Bring small cash for massage and donations.

title: Best time to visit
description: November to February is most comfortable. Visit early in the morning or late afternoon, and pair it with the Grand Palace nearby.

title: Good to know
description: Across the river, Wat Arun is a short ferry ride away and is beautiful at sunset from the eastern bank.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Chiang Mai International (CNX), usually via Bangkok. The temple is about 30-40 minutes by car from the old city up a winding mountain road. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Cover shoulders and knees; wraps can be borrowed at the entrance. Wear shoes that are easy to remove. Bring a light layer, as it is cooler on the mountain.

title: Best time to visit
description: November to February is cool and clear. Arrive early for morning chanting and fewer visitors, or late afternoon for sunset views over the city.

title: Make it special
description: Hike the Monk's Trail from the city edge with a guide, visiting a small forest temple on the way.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Phuket International (HKT); piers on Phuket's east coast are about 40-60 minutes by car. Boats also leave from Phang Nga and Krabi. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Book a private long-tail or yacht in advance. Pack sunscreen, a hat, swimwear and a dry bag. Dress modestly when visiting Koh Panyee.

title: Best time to visit
description: November to April is the dry season, with calm seas. Leave early to reach popular islands before day trippers, and time canoeing with the tide.

title: Make it special
description: Charter a private yacht for the day with a sea-canoe guide, and end with sunset among the karsts.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Krabi International (KBV); Ao Nang is about 30-40 minutes by car, then a long-tail boat takes 10-15 minutes to Railay. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Pack light, as you will step off boats into shallow water. Bring swimwear, reef-safe sunscreen and water shoes. For climbing, book a qualified instructor.

title: Best time to visit
description: November to April is dry with calm seas. Arrive early before day boats, and stay late for sunset on the west beach.

title: Make it special
description: Book a private long-tail to nearby islands such as Poda and Chicken Island for early-morning snorkelling.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into London Heathrow (LHR). The Elizabeth line reaches Liverpool Street in about 35 minutes, then it is a short taxi ride; Tower Hill Underground station is next to the Tower. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Book tickets online in advance. Pakistani passport holders need a UK visitor visa, applied for well ahead. Wear comfortable shoes for stairs and cobbles, and bring a light waterproof.

title: Best time to visit
description: April to October has the longest days. Arrive at opening and go straight to the Crown Jewels before queues form. Weekdays outside school holidays are quieter.

title: Make it special
description: Apply months ahead for tickets to the Ceremony of the Keys, or book a private early-access tour.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into London Heathrow (LHR). The Elizabeth line reaches Tottenham Court Road in about 40 minutes, a five-minute walk from the museum. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: General admission is free, but booking a timed entry slot online is advised. Pakistani passport holders need a UK visitor visa. Bring comfortable shoes and a light bag; large bags are not allowed.

title: Best time to visit
description: Open year-round. Weekday mornings are quietest; late afternoon is calmer than midday.

title: Make it special
description: Book a private guided tour of the museum's highlights, followed by afternoon tea in Bloomsbury.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Edinburgh Airport (EDI), about 30 minutes into the city by tram or car. From London, trains from King's Cross take around 4 hours 30 minutes. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Book castle tickets online for a timed entry. Pakistani passport holders need a UK visitor visa. Wear good shoes for steep, cobbled streets, and bring layers and a waterproof whatever the season.

title: Best time to visit
description: May to September brings long days. August is festival month, with the Fringe and the Military Tattoo on the castle esplanade, but it is very busy. Visit the castle early in the morning.

title: Make it special
description: Book a private guide for the castle and the closes of the Old Town, then dine with a view of the castle lit at night.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Inverness (INV), then drive about 2 hours 30 minutes to the Skye Bridge. From Glasgow the drive takes around 5 hours through the Highlands. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Book hotels and restaurants well ahead, as there are few of them. Pakistani passport holders need a UK visitor visa. Pack waterproofs, warm layers and walking boots, plus insect repellent for midges in summer.

title: Best time to visit
description: May to September offers long days; May and September are quieter and have fewer midges. Walk the famous viewpoints at sunrise, before the day visitors arrive.

title: Make it special
description: Take a private boat trip under the Cuillin to Loch Coruisk, then dine on local seafood at a celebrated island restaurant.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into London Heathrow (LHR). Trains from London Paddington reach Bath Spa in about 1 hour 30 minutes, and the Baths are a ten-minute walk from the station. Bristol Airport (BRS) is around 45 minutes by car. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Book timed tickets online. Pakistani passport holders need a UK visitor visa. Bring swimwear if you plan to visit the spa.

title: Best time to visit
description: April to October is pleasant; December brings a Christmas market. Arrive at opening, or visit in summer evenings, when the Great Bath is lit by torchlight.

title: Make it special
description: Stay in a hotel with its own thermal spa, and book a private evening soak in natural spring water.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Paris Charles de Gaulle (CDG) or Orly (ORY). From CDG, allow 45-60 minutes by car or RER B train to central Paris; the tower is near Bir-Hakeim and Trocadéro metro stations. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Book timed tickets online well ahead, especially for the summit, which can close in high wind. Security checks are airport-style, so travel light. Bring a layer for the top, where it is noticeably cooler. A Schengen visa is required.

title: Best time to visit
description: October to April is quieter. Go at opening or around sunset to see the city in daylight and then lit up. Summer brings the longest queues.

title: Make it special
description: Reserve a table at Le Jules Verne on the second floor, reached by its own private lift, or take a private evening cruise on the Seine that passes beneath the tower as it sparkles.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Paris Charles de Gaulle (CDG) or Orly (ORY), then allow 45-60 minutes by car or RER train to central Paris. Palais-Royal-Musée du Louvre metro station is beside the museum. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Timed-entry tickets should be booked online in advance. Wear comfortable shoes, as the galleries cover several kilometres. Large bags are not allowed in the galleries. A Schengen visa is required.

title: Best time to visit
description: Weekday mornings from November to March are calmest. Arrive at opening and see the Mona Lisa first, or save it for late in the day when crowds thin.

title: Make it special
description: A private guide can build a route around your interests, from Islamic art to French painting, and avoid the busiest rooms.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Paris Charles de Gaulle (CDG) or Orly (ORY). Versailles is about 40 minutes from central Paris by RER C train or car, with the palace a 10-minute walk from Versailles Château Rive Gauche station. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Book a timed palace ticket in advance, as queues can be long. Wear walking shoes; the estate is large and the gravel paths are uneven. A Schengen visa is required.

title: Best time to visit
description: May, June and September bring the gardens at their best with fewer crowds than midsummer. Arrive at opening for the Hall of Mirrors, then spend the afternoon outdoors.

title: Make it special
description: Stay at Le Grand Contrôle inside the estate, which offers guests private early access to the palace, and dine at its restaurant overlooking the Orangery gardens.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Paris Charles de Gaulle (CDG) or Orly (ORY), take the TGV from Paris Montparnasse to Rennes (about 1 hour 30 minutes), then a coach to the Mont (about 1 hour 15 minutes). Free shuttles run from the mainland car parks across the bridge. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Book the abbey ticket in advance in summer. The climb to the abbey is steep with many steps, so wear sturdy shoes and bring a windproof layer. A Schengen visa is required.

title: Best time to visit
description: April to June and September to October are calmer than July and August. Check the tide tables for high spring tides, when the island is fully surrounded, and come in the evening when day crowds have gone.

title: Good to know
description: Never walk out on the sands alone. Quicksand and fast tides make the bay dangerous; cross it only with a licensed guide.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Nice Côte d'Azur (NCE). Èze is about 30 minutes by car along the Moyenne Corniche, and a local bus runs from Nice. The train stops at Èze-sur-Mer on the coast, below the village. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Wear shoes with good grip; the lanes are steep and cobbled. For the Nietzsche Path, allow about an hour downhill or more going up, and carry water. A Schengen visa is required.

title: Best time to visit
description: May, June and September are warm without the midsummer crowds. Arrive early in the morning before tour coaches, or stay for sunset from a hotel terrace.

title: Make it special
description: Book a long lunch on the terrace of La Chèvre d'Or, then take a private boat from Nice or Monaco along the coast in the afternoon.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Rome Fiumicino (FCO). The Leonardo Express train reaches Roma Termini in about 32 minutes, or allow 45-60 minutes by car. Colosseo metro station is directly opposite. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Book timed tickets well in advance, particularly for the underground and arena levels. Wear comfortable shoes for uneven stone, and carry water and sun protection in summer. A Schengen visa is required.

title: Best time to visit
description: November to March and early mornings year-round are least crowded. Late afternoon light on the travertine is warm and soft. July and August are very hot.

title: Make it special
description: A private archaeologist-guide can combine the Colosseum's underground with the Forum and Palatine, bringing the ruins to life at a relaxed pace.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Rome Fiumicino (FCO), then take the Leonardo Express to Roma Termini (about 32 minutes) or a car to the Vatican (about 45 minutes). Ottaviano metro station is a short walk from the museum entrance. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Book timed tickets online well ahead. Shoulders and knees must be covered, for both men and women. Large bags go to the cloakroom, and the full route involves several kilometres of walking.

title: Best time to visit
description: November to February, excluding holidays, is quietest. Take the earliest entry of the day or a late slot, and avoid days when entry is free, which draw large crowds.

title: Make it special
description: Private early-morning tours, arranged through the museums, let you see the Sistine Chapel before general opening, sometimes joining the keeper of the keys as the galleries are unlocked.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Florence (FLR), about 20 minutes to the centre by tram or car, or Pisa (PSA), about an hour by train. From Rome, high-speed trains reach Firenze Santa Maria Novella in about 1 hour 30 minutes. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Reserve a timed entry in advance, and book separately for the Duomo dome climb, which has 463 steps. Wear comfortable shoes. A Schengen visa is required.

title: Best time to visit
description: November to March is calmest. Book the first entry of the morning, or a late-afternoon slot when tour groups have left.

title: Make it special
description: A private art historian can lead you through the highlights and then across the river to the Pitti Palace and Boboli Gardens.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Venice Marco Polo (VCE). A private water taxi reaches the centre in about 30 minutes; the Alilaguna waterbus takes about an hour. Trains from Florence arrive at Santa Lucia station in about 2 hours 15 minutes. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Book timed entry to the Basilica and Doge's Palace ahead. The Basilica requires covered shoulders and knees, and large bags are not allowed. Pack flat, grippy shoes for bridges and wet stone. Day visitors pay an access fee on certain peak dates. A Schengen visa is required.

title: Best time to visit
description: April to June and September to October are best. Early morning and evening are far quieter than midday, when day-trippers arrive. From autumn to winter, high tides can flood St Mark's Square.

title: Make it special
description: Take a private gondola or a classic wooden launch at dusk along the Grand Canal, then dine at a palazzo hotel terrace facing the water.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Naples (NAP). Positano is about 1 hour 30 minutes to 2 hours by car. Alternatively, take the train to Salerno and continue by ferry along the coast in season. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Pack flat shoes; the villages are built on steep steps. Book hotels, restaurants and boats well ahead for summer. A Schengen visa is required.

title: Best time to visit
description: May, June and September offer warm seas with fewer crowds than July and August. Many hotels and ferry services close or reduce from November to March.

title: Make it special
description: Charter a private boat for a day to swim in quiet coves and cross to Capri, and walk part of the Path of the Gods above Positano in the cool of the morning.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Granada (GRX), about 25 minutes by car, or Málaga (AGP), about 1 hour 30 minutes by road. High-speed trains link Madrid with Granada in around 3 hours 30 minutes. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Tickets sell out weeks ahead, so book early; entry to the Nasrid Palaces is at a fixed time that is strictly kept. Carry the passport used on the booking. Wear comfortable shoes and bring sun protection. A Schengen visa is required.

title: Best time to visit
description: March to May and October to November are ideal, with mild weather and gardens in flower in spring. Take an early palace slot, and return for a night visit, when the palaces are softly lit and quiet.

title: Make it special
description: Book a private guide who reads the Arabic inscriptions, then watch sunset over the Alhambra from the Mirador de San Nicolás in the Albaicín.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Barcelona El Prat (BCN), about 30 minutes by car to the basilica. Sagrada Família metro station, on lines 2 and 5, is beside it. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Book timed tickets online in advance, with tower access if you want it. Shoulders should be covered and very short shorts avoided. The tower descent is by narrow spiral stairs. A Schengen visa is required.

title: Best time to visit
description: Any season works. Visit in the late afternoon, when sunlight through the western windows fills the nave with red and gold; mornings bring the cooler blue light of the eastern side.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Seville (SVQ), about 20-25 minutes by car to the centre. High-speed AVE trains from Madrid reach Seville in about 2 hours 30 minutes. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Book a timed ticket online in advance; the royal apartments on the upper floor need a separate reservation. Bring sun protection and water. A Schengen visa is required.

title: Best time to visit
description: March to May and October to November are pleasant; spring brings orange blossom and Seville's festivals. Summer afternoons often exceed 40°C, so visit at opening.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Madrid-Barajas (MAD), about 25-30 minutes by car to the museum. Banco de España and Atocha metro stations are each a short walk away. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Buy timed tickets online to avoid queues. Photography is not permitted in the galleries. Large bags go to the cloakroom. A Schengen visa is required.

title: Best time to visit
description: Any season suits a museum, but spring and autumn are best for walking between Madrid's galleries and the Retiro Park. Weekday mornings are quietest.

title: Make it special
description: Arrange a private guided visit focused on Velázquez and Goya, then lunch in the Retiro Park or at the Ritz terrace opposite.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Zurich (ZRH) or Geneva (GVA). Trains reach Zermatt in about 3 hours 30 minutes to 4 hours, changing at Visp. Zermatt is car-free, so drivers park at Täsch and take the 12-minute shuttle train. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Bring warm layers, sunglasses and sun cream; it is cold and bright at altitude even in summer. Check the summit webcams before buying tickets, as cloud can hide the peak. A Schengen visa is required.

title: Best time to visit
description: July to September for hiking and clear views; December to April for snow. Take the first train of the morning for the calmest weather and the best chance of a cloud-free Matterhorn.

title: Make it special
description: Book a private mountain guide for a glacier walk, or a helicopter flight around the Matterhorn from Zermatt's heliport.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Zurich (ZRH); trains reach Interlaken in about 2 hours. From Interlaken, allow around 2 hours to the Jungfraujoch via Grindelwald and the Eiger Express, or via Lauterbrunnen and Kleine Scheidegg. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Reserve seats on the final train in high season. Bring warm clothes, sunglasses and sun cream. Move slowly at the top; the thin air can cause headaches and breathlessness. A Schengen visa is required.

title: Best time to visit
description: Clear days from June to September give the widest views, but winter can be equally bright. Go on the first trains of the morning, before clouds build and crowds arrive.

title: Make it special
description: Stay at the Victoria-Jungfrau in Interlaken, and arrange a private guide to walk from the Jungfraujoch across the glacier to the Mönchsjoch Hut in summer.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Zurich (ZRH). Direct trains reach Lucerne in about 1 hour, and the Chapel Bridge is a few minutes' walk from the station. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Comfortable shoes for cobbles and the wall walk. Bring a light layer for boat trips. A Schengen visa is required.

title: Best time to visit
description: May to October is best for lake cruises and mountain excursions. December brings Christmas markets. Early morning is quietest on the bridge.

title: Make it special
description: Take a private boat across Lake Lucerne, then ride up Mount Rigi or Pilatus for lunch above the clouds.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Zurich (ZRH) or Geneva (GVA). Reach Zermatt by train in about 3 hours 30 minutes to 4 hours via Visp; the Glacier Express departs from Zermatt station. The route can also be taken in reverse from St Moritz. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Seat reservations are compulsory and sell out in summer; Excellence Class should be booked months ahead. Carry a layer, as the carriages are warm in the sun but the stations are cold. A Schengen visa is required.

title: Best time to visit
description: Summer offers green valleys and long daylight; winter brings deep snow and crisp views. Sit on the side recommended by the operator for your direction of travel.

title: Make it special
description: Book Excellence Class, then continue to St Moritz's grand lakeside hotels for a few days in the Engadin.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Athens (ATH). Allow about 40 minutes by car or metro to the centre; Akropoli metro station is beside the Acropolis Museum and the southern entrance. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Book a timed entry slot online in advance. Wear shoes with good grip; the ancient marble is polished and slippery. Bring water, a hat and sun cream, as there is little shade. A Schengen visa is required.

title: Best time to visit
description: April to June and September to October are best. Go at opening or in the last hours of the day for softer light and fewer people; midday in July and August is very hot.

title: Make it special
description: Take a private archaeologist-guide for the first entry of the day, then dine on a rooftop in Plaka or at the Hotel Grande Bretagne facing the floodlit Parthenon.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Santorini (JTR), about 25-30 minutes by car to Oia. Ferries from Piraeus near Athens take about 5 to 8 hours depending on the vessel. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Pack flat shoes for steep, polished steps, plus sunglasses and sun cream. Book hotels and sunset tables months ahead for summer. A Schengen visa is required.

title: Best time to visit
description: May, June, September and early October are warm with calmer crowds than July and August. The best light is at sunset, but early morning in Oia is peaceful and almost empty.

title: Make it special
description: Charter a private catamaran for the afternoon to swim at the volcanic hot springs and watch the sunset from the water, with dinner on board.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Athens (ATH), then take the train to Kalambaka (about 4 to 5 hours) or drive (about 4 hours). Thessaloniki (SKG) is about 3 hours by car. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Dress modestly: women should wear skirts below the knee (wraps are often provided at the entrance), men long trousers, and shoulders covered for all. Each monastery closes on a different weekday, so check before you go. Expect many steps.

title: Best time to visit
description: April to June and September to October bring mild weather and clear views. Arrive at the first monasteries early, and stay for sunset from the viewpoints along the road.

title: Make it special
description: Walk the old monks' footpaths between monasteries with a private local guide, and end with sunset over the rocks.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Mykonos (JMK), about 10 minutes by car to town. Ferries from Piraeus or Rafina near Athens take about 2 hours 30 minutes to 5 hours. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Bring sun protection and a hat for Delos, which has almost no shade. Check Delos boat times, as sailings depend on the weather. A Schengen visa is required.

title: Best time to visit
description: May, June and September are warm and calmer than July and August, when the meltemi wind blows hard and the island is at its busiest. Little Venice is at its best at sunset.

title: Make it special
description: Take a private boat to Delos with an archaeologist-guide early in the day, then continue to Rhenia's quiet coves for a swim.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Kansai International (KIX); the Haruka express reaches Kyoto Station in about 75 minutes. From Kyoto Station, JR Inari Station is two stops (about 5 minutes) and faces the shrine gate. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Wear comfortable shoes for many stone steps, and carry water. The shrine is free to enter. Pakistani passport holders need a Japanese visa arranged in advance. Bow slightly when passing through the main gate and walk to the side of the path.

title: Best time to visit
description: November for autumn colour and late March to early April for cherry blossom, though these are busiest. Go at dawn or in the early evening, when the lanterns are lit and the trails are quiet.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Kansai International (KIX) and take the Haruka express to Kyoto Station (about 75 minutes). From there, Kinkaku-ji is about 30-40 minutes by taxi or city bus in north-western Kyoto. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: The garden route is one-way and busy, so allow time. The pavilion itself cannot be entered. Pakistani passport holders need a Japanese visa arranged in advance.

title: Best time to visit
description: Arrive at opening for calm water and reflections. Autumn maples in November are lovely, and a rare snowfall in winter makes the gold stand out against white.

title: Good to know
description: Combine the visit with nearby Ryōan-ji and its famous rock garden, a short taxi ride away.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Kansai International (KIX) and take the Haruka express to Kyoto Station (about 75 minutes). From Kyoto Station, the JR Sagano Line reaches Saga-Arashiyama in about 15 minutes. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Walk the grove quietly and keep to the path. Wear comfortable shoes; shoes are removed inside temple halls, so socks without holes help. Pakistani passport holders need a Japanese visa arranged in advance.

title: Best time to visit
description: Go at dawn, before tour groups arrive. November brings autumn colour and early April cherry blossom, both busy seasons.

title: Make it special
description: Stay at Hoshinoya Kyoto, arriving by private boat along the river, or take a traditional boat through the Hozu river gorge.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Tokyo Haneda (HND), about 30-40 minutes by car or train, or Narita (NRT), about 1 hour by direct train to Asakusa Station, a few minutes' walk from the temple. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Carry some cash for small stalls and fortune slips. The temple grounds are free. Pakistani passport holders need a Japanese visa arranged in advance.

title: Best time to visit
description: Early morning is quiet and the grounds stay open after dark, when the buildings are lit. The Sanja Matsuri festival fills Asakusa in May, and cherry blossom follows in late March to early April.

title: Make it special
description: Take a private rickshaw ride through Asakusa, then continue by boat along the Sumida River.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Tokyo Haneda (HND) or Narita (NRT). The Romancecar from Shinjuku reaches Hakone-Yumoto in about 1 hour 30 minutes, or take the shinkansen from Tokyo to Odawara in about 35 minutes and change for the local line. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Pack light; ryokan provide yukata robes. Communal baths are taken without swimwear, and many restrict tattoos, so a room with a private onsen is ideal. Pakistani passport holders need a Japanese visa arranged in advance.

title: Best time to visit
description: Late October to February gives the clearest Fuji views, often in the morning. Autumn colour peaks in November. Summer is humid, and Fuji is often hidden by cloud.

title: Make it special
description: Book a ryokan suite with an open-air bath facing the mountains and an in-room kaiseki dinner, served course by course by your attendant.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Munich (MUC). Trains from Munich run to Füssen in about two hours, then a short bus ride reaches Hohenschwangau; by car it is roughly two hours. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Buy timed tour tickets online well ahead, as same-day tickets often sell out; tickets are for a fixed entry slot. The walk up from the village takes about 30 to 40 minutes, so wear comfortable shoes. Photography is not allowed inside. A Schengen visa is required.

title: Best time to visit
description: May, June, September and early October bring mild weather and green or golden hillsides. Take the earliest tour slot to avoid the midday crowds. Winter snow is beautiful, but the Marienbrücke may close in icy conditions.

title: Make it special
description: Stay a night by the Alpsee and walk up at first light before the coaches arrive, or arrange a private guide who can also take you to Linderhof Palace, Ludwig's smaller retreat.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Berlin Brandenburg (BER). Airport trains reach the city centre in about 30 minutes. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Visits to the Reichstag dome are free but must be registered online in advance, with photo ID on the day. Book timed museum tickets ahead and wear good walking shoes; the city is large and spread out. A Schengen visa is required.

title: Best time to visit
description: May to September offers long days and outdoor cafés. December brings Christmas markets. Visit the Reichstag dome at sunset for the view over the Tiergarten.

title: Make it special
description: Hire a private historian-guide for a Cold War walk, from Checkpoint Charlie to Bernauer Strasse, then end with dinner in Mitte.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Frankfurt (FRA). Trains reach Bingen or Koblenz in around one to one and a half hours, and riverside rail lines run along both banks. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Check river-boat timetables in advance, as sailings are reduced outside the main season. Bring a light layer for the deck and comfortable shoes for castle climbs. A Schengen visa is required.

title: Best time to visit
description: May to October is the boating season. September and October add the grape harvest and local wine festivals. Mornings on the water are calmest.

title: Make it special
description: Book a private tasting at a family Riesling estate, then take the afternoon boat downstream past the Lorelei.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Frankfurt (FRA), Stuttgart (STR) or EuroAirport Basel-Mulhouse-Freiburg (BSL). Trains from Frankfurt reach Baden-Baden in about an hour and a half; a car is best for the high road and villages. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Bring layers and a rain jacket, as mountain weather changes quickly. Walking shoes are essential for trails and waterfalls. Some traditional spas have nude-only areas, so check the house rules before booking. A Schengen visa is required.

title: Best time to visit
description: June to September suits walking and driving. October brings autumn colour. December to March brings snow and cross-country skiing on the higher ground.

title: Make it special
description: Spend an afternoon at the Friedrichsbad, then dine in one of the Black Forest's Michelin-starred restaurants.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Vienna (VIE). The City Airport Train reaches Wien Mitte in about 16 minutes, then the U4 line runs to Schönbrunn station. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Book a timed ticket for the palace tour online, as slots sell out in summer. Allow extra time for the gardens and wear comfortable shoes for the climb to the Gloriette. A Schengen visa is required.

title: Best time to visit
description: April to June and September to October have pleasant weather and gardens in bloom. Arrive for the first entry slot. In December, a Christmas market fills the forecourt.

title: Make it special
description: Take a private after-hours or early guided tour where available, then an evening concert in the Orangery.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Salzburg (SZG), about 20 minutes from the centre, or into Vienna (VIE) or Munich (MUC). Trains from Vienna take about two and a half hours; from Munich, around one and a half to two hours. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Book Salzburg Festival tickets months ahead if you plan to attend. Old-town streets are cobbled, so wear flat shoes. Bring an umbrella; Salzburg is known for rain. A Schengen visa is required.

title: Best time to visit
description: May, June and September bring mild weather with fewer crowds. July and August are festival season, lively but busy. Advent brings Christmas markets in the cathedral square.

title: Make it special
description: Book a private chamber-music evening or a dinner concert at the fortress, then return through the lit old town.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Salzburg (SZG); Hallstatt is about one and a half hours by car. By train, Hallstatt station sits across the lake, and a small ferry crosses to the village in about ten minutes. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Book accommodation early, as rooms are few. Respect residents' privacy and keep to public paths. Bring layers and good shoes for the salt mine, which stays cool year-round. A Schengen visa is required.

title: Best time to visit
description: May, June and September to October offer mild weather. Visit early morning or evening, when the day-trip crowds have gone and the lake is often still. Winter snow is atmospheric, and much quieter.

title: Make it special
description: Take a private boat on the lake at dawn, or a guided walk in the Dachstein caves at nearby Obertraun.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Lisbon (LIS). Belém is about 25 minutes by taxi from the airport; from central Lisbon, tram 15 or a short train from Cais do Sodré takes around 20 minutes. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Book timed entry to the monastery and tower online, and check closing days before you go. Wear flat shoes for cobbles and the tower's narrow stairs. A Schengen visa is required.

title: Best time to visit
description: March to June and September to October have mild weather. Arrive at opening time; queues build by late morning. Late afternoon light on the riverfront is soft and golden.

title: Make it special
description: Arrange a private guide for the monastery, then a sunset sail on the Tagus past the Belém Tower.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Lisbon (LIS). Trains from Lisbon's Rossio station reach Sintra in about 40 minutes, and a car takes a similar time. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Buy timed tickets for Pena Palace online, especially in summer. Roads to the palaces are narrow and steep, so use the local shuttle, a taxi or a private driver rather than driving yourself. Bring a light jacket, as Sintra is often cooler and mistier than Lisbon. A Schengen visa is required.

title: Best time to visit
description: Spring and autumn are ideal. Take the first entry slot at Pena, before the tour groups. Weekdays are quieter than weekends.

title: Make it special
description: Hire a private guide and driver for a full day covering Pena, Regaleira and the Monserrate gardens, then lunch on the coast at Cascais.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Porto (OPO), about 30 minutes from the centre. Trains from Lisbon take about three hours. The Douro line runs from Porto's São Bento station to Pinhão in about two and a half hours, along the river. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Book quinta visits and tastings ahead, as many are by appointment. Porto is hilly, so wear comfortable shoes. Arrange a designated driver if you plan to taste. A Schengen visa is required.

title: Best time to visit
description: May, June and September are ideal. The harvest runs from mid-September into October, when estates are busiest and most atmospheric. Midsummer in the valley can be very hot.

title: Make it special
description: Charter a private boat on the Douro, or take a vintage tasting at a historic quinta with lunch among the terraces.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Faro (FAO). The central Algarve is 30 to 60 minutes by car from the airport, and Lagos about an hour. From Lisbon, it is about two and a half to three hours by road or train. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Book cave trips with licensed operators, as access rules for Benagil have tightened. Bring sun protection, water and good shoes for the clifftop trail. A Schengen visa is required.

title: Best time to visit
description: May, June and September have warm seas and fewer crowds than July and August. Go to Benagil early in the morning, when seas are often calmest. Winter is mild and suits walking.

title: Make it special
description: Charter a private boat along the cliffs, stopping at coves only reachable from the sea.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Amsterdam Schiphol (AMS). Trains reach Amsterdam Centraal in about 15 to 20 minutes. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Book timed tickets online for the Rijksmuseum, Van Gogh Museum and Anne Frank House, which sells out weeks ahead. Watch for cyclists and keep out of bike lanes. Bring a rain jacket in every season. A Schengen visa is required.

title: Best time to visit
description: April to June and September have mild weather. Visit museums at opening time or late in the day. The canals are prettiest in the evening, when the bridges are lit.

title: Make it special
description: Take a private boat on a restored saloon launch at dusk, with drinks on board, through the quieter western canals.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Amsterdam Schiphol (AMS). Seasonal express buses run from Schiphol to Keukenhof in about 30 minutes, and it is similar by car. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Buy timed tickets online in advance; the park only opens in spring. Bring layers and a light rain jacket, as April weather is changeable. Comfortable shoes help, since the paths cover several kilometres. A Schengen visa is required.

title: Best time to visit
description: Mid-April is usually peak tulip season, though it varies with the weather. Arrive at opening or come in late afternoon to avoid tour coaches. Weekdays are quieter.

title: Make it special
description: Take a private guide by bicycle through the surrounding bulb fields, or a scenic flight over them in April.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Amsterdam Schiphol (AMS). Trains reach Rotterdam in about 30 minutes; from Rotterdam, the water bus reaches Kinderdijk in around 40 minutes, or a car takes about 30 minutes. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Buy tickets online for the museum mills and boat. The site is open and windy, so bring a warm, waterproof layer. Bicycles can be rented to ride the canal paths. A Schengen visa is required.

title: Best time to visit
description: April to October is best. On National Mill Day, the second weekend of May, many mills turn and open their doors. Early morning or late afternoon light suits photography.

title: Make it special
description: Arrive by private water taxi from Rotterdam and walk the mill path at sunset.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Dubrovnik (DBV), about 30 minutes from the old town by car. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Buy wall tickets in advance or at the entrance, and bring water and sun protection; there is little shade on the walls. Wear flat, non-slip shoes for polished stone. Dress modestly in churches. Croatia is in the Schengen area, so a Schengen visa is required.

title: Best time to visit
description: May, June, September and October offer warm weather with fewer crowds than midsummer. Walk the walls at opening time or late afternoon, when cruise passengers thin out. The Dubrovnik Summer Festival fills July and August with open-air performances.

title: Make it special
description: Take a private boat to the island of Lokrum or the Elaphiti Islands, and return for dinner on a terrace overlooking the old harbour.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Zagreb (ZAG) or Zadar (ZAD). The park is about two hours by car from Zagreb and around one and a half hours from Zadar. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Buy timed tickets online, which are required in the busy season. Wear good walking shoes, as boardwalks can be wet and have no railings. Bring a light jacket; the park is cooler than the coast. A Schengen visa is required.

title: Best time to visit
description: May, June, September and October are best, with strong waterfalls in spring and autumn colour in October. Arrive at opening time for quiet walkways. In winter, parts of the park freeze and some trails close.

title: Make it special
description: Book a private naturalist guide for an early walk before the gates fill, then lunch at a country restaurant in the Lika hills.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Split (SPU), about 30 minutes from the centre by car. Split is also a ferry hub for the islands. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Buy tickets for the cathedral, bell tower and substructures on site. Wear comfortable shoes for stone steps. Dress modestly in the cathedral, with shoulders and knees covered. A Schengen visa is required.

title: Best time to visit
description: May, June, September and October bring warm weather and fewer crowds. Visit early morning or in the evening, when the Peristyle is lit and the day-trippers leave.

title: Make it special
description: Take a private guided walk at dusk, then dine on the Riva waterfront.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Split (SPU). From Split harbour, fast catamarans reach Hvar town in about one hour, and car ferries reach Stari Grad in around two hours. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Book ferry and catamaran seats ahead in summer. Bring sun protection and water shoes for pebble beaches. Hvar town has rules against wearing swimwear in the streets. A Schengen visa is required.

title: Best time to visit
description: June and September are ideal, with warm seas and fewer crowds. Late June to July brings lavender in bloom. July and August are busiest, especially in Hvar town's nightlife.

title: Make it special
description: Charter a private boat to the Pakleni Islands for swimming and a seafood lunch, returning to Hvar at sunset.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Beijing Capital (PEK) or Beijing Daxing (PKX). Mutianyu lies about 70 kilometres northeast of the city, usually 1.5 to 2 hours by private car, a little less from Capital airport. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Wear shoes with good grip, as some steps are steep and uneven. Carry water and a layer for the wind on the ridge, and bring your passport, which is needed to buy tickets in China.

title: Best time to visit
description: April to May and September to October bring clear skies and mild weather, with October's autumn colour the highlight. Arrive at opening on a weekday to have long stretches to yourself; avoid Chinese national holidays, especially the first week of October.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Beijing Capital (PEK), about 45 minutes by car, or Beijing Daxing (PKX), about an hour. Tiananmen East station on Metro Line 1 is the closest stop to the entrance. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Tickets are timed, sold in advance under your passport name and capped each day, so book several days ahead, especially in summer. Bring the same passport for entry. Expect a lot of walking on stone paving, so wear comfortable shoes. The museum is closed on most Mondays.

title: Best time to visit
description: Spring and autumn are the most comfortable, with October skies usually clearest. Enter at opening and head straight for the inner courts before the tour groups arrive. Winter is cold but quiet, and snow on the yellow roofs is a rare treat.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Xi'an Xianyang (XIY), or take the high-speed train from Beijing, about 4.5 to 6 hours. The site is roughly 40 kilometres east of the city centre, about an hour by car. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Buy tickets in advance with your passport details and hire a licensed guide, as signage is limited and the history makes far more sense explained. Wear comfortable shoes; the three pits and museum involve plenty of walking.

title: Best time to visit
description: March to May and September to November are mild. Arrive at opening, visit Pit 1 first, then the smaller pits once the tour groups move in. Avoid Chinese national holidays, when the halls are packed.

title: Make it special
description: Pair the visit with an evening cycle or walk along Xi'an's 14-kilometre Ming city wall, followed by a private dinner of Shaanxi dishes in the old Muslim quarter.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Guilin Liangjiang (KWL). Cruises leave from piers south of Guilin, about 45 minutes by car, and end at Yangshuo, around 1.5 hours by road back to Guilin. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Book cruise tickets ahead in peak season and carry your passport. Bring a light rain jacket and sun protection, as the weather changes quickly on the water.

title: Best time to visit
description: April to October has the fullest river and greenest hills, though summer is hot and wet. September to November is often the best balance of clear air and good water levels. In the dry winter months low water can shorten the cruise route. Early morning brings mist around the peaks.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Bali's Ngurah Rai International (DPS). Ubud is 1 to 1.5 hours by car, longer in heavy traffic, and Tegallalang a further 30 minutes north. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Carry a sarong and sash for temple visits, which are often provided at the entrance. Wear shoes with grip for the terrace paths, which can be muddy. Small cash is useful for donations and village entry fees.

title: Best time to visit
description: April to October is the dry season, with May, June and September the most pleasant. Visit Tegallalang soon after sunrise for mist and few people. Galungan, a major Balinese festival, brings bamboo poles and offerings to every village.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Bali's Ngurah Rai International (DPS). The temple is about 45 minutes to an hour south by car, depending on traffic. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Cover your knees; sarongs and sashes are provided at the gate. Remove hats and sunglasses near the monkeys and keep bags zipped. Buy kecak tickets early, online or at the gate, as the seats fill well before sunset.

title: Best time to visit
description: April to October brings dry weather and the clearest sunsets. Arrive in the late afternoon, walk the cliff paths, then take your seat for the kecak dance at dusk.

title: Make it special
description: Book a sunset dinner at one of the cliff-edge resorts nearby, or a private surf lesson on the Bukit's reef breaks earlier in the day.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Yogyakarta International (YIA), about an hour by car to Borobudur, or connect via Jakarta or Bali. From central Yogyakarta the drive is 1 to 1.5 hours. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Book the climbing ticket online well ahead, as daily numbers are capped; otherwise you can only view the monument from the grounds. Cover shoulders and knees, bring a hat and water, and expect heat by mid-morning.

title: Best time to visit
description: May to September is the dry season. Arrive early morning for softer light and cooler air. Vesak, usually in May or June, brings a candlelit procession of monks from nearby Mendut, though crowds are very large.

title: Make it special
description: Watch the sunrise over the monument and the surrounding volcanoes from Punthuk Setumbu hill, then combine the day with the Hindu temples of Prambanan with a private guide.

title: How to reach
description: Fly to Labuan Bajo Komodo Airport (LBJ), usually via Bali (DPS), a flight of around an hour, or via Jakarta. Boats reach Rinca in about two hours and Komodo island in three to four. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Dragon walks must be made with park rangers; keep to the trail and never approach the animals. Bring reef-safe sunscreen, a hat, sturdy shoes for Padar and seasickness tablets. Diving here suits experienced divers because of strong currents.

title: Best time to visit
description: April to November is the dry season, with calmer seas and clear water. Manta sightings are good across much of the year. Plan an early start for Padar at sunrise and dragon walks, before the midday heat.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Hanoi's Noi Bai International (HAN). The expressway to the Ha Long piers takes about 2.5 hours by car. Van Don International (VDO) is closer but has fewer flights. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Book a reputable small-ship cruise well ahead and choose one or two nights; a day trip feels rushed. Pack soft shoes for cave steps, swimwear and a light layer for the evenings on deck.

title: Best time to visit
description: March to May and September to November bring the best mix of calm water and comfortable weather. June to August is hot and can bring typhoons that cancel sailings. Winter is cool and often misty, which suits the scenery but not swimming.

title: Make it special
description: Charter a private junk for your party, with a chef, sunset drinks on the sundeck and an early morning kayak before other boats arrive.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Da Nang International (DAD). Hoi An is about 45 minutes south by car. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: An old town ticket covers entry to a set number of historic houses and halls. Dress modestly for temples and assembly halls. Tailors can make clothes within a day or two, so order early in your stay.

title: Best time to visit
description: February to April is dry and mild. Summer is hot but good for the beaches. October and November bring heavy rain and occasional flooding of the old town. Visit at dawn for quiet lanes and after dusk for the lanterns.

title: Good to know
description: Cars are kept out of much of the old town, so arrive on foot, by bicycle or by electric cart from your hotel.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Noi Bai International (HAN), about 45 minutes by car from the Old Quarter. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Carry small Vietnamese dong notes for street stalls. Cross roads at a slow, steady pace so motorbikes can flow around you. Cover shoulders and knees for temples.

title: Best time to visit
description: October to December and March to April are the most comfortable, with mild days and low humidity. Summer is hot and wet, and January to February can be grey and cool. Early morning shows the lake at its most local, with tai chi and badminton on the shore.

title: Make it special
description: Take a private evening food walk with a local guide, ending with a water puppet performance near the lake.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Phu Bai International (HUI), about 30 minutes from the city. From Hoi An, the drive over the Hai Van Pass takes around three hours. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Wear light clothing that covers shoulders and knees for the pagodas and tombs. Bring a hat and water, as the citadel has little shade. A driver makes it easy to combine two or three tombs in a day.

title: Best time to visit
description: February to April is the best window, mild and mostly dry. Summer is very hot, and September to December brings heavy rain and floods. Start at the citadel early, visit the tombs in the afternoon light, and finish with a boat on the river at dusk.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Incheon International (ICN). The AREX express train reaches Seoul Station in about 45 minutes, then it is a short subway or taxi ride to Gyeongbokgung station on Line 3. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: The palace is closed on Tuesdays. Wear comfortable shoes for the gravel courtyards, and consider renting a hanbok nearby for free entry and a different experience of the palace.

title: Best time to visit
description: April brings cherry and magnolia blossom, and late October to early November autumn colour. Arrive at opening for quiet courtyards, and check dates for the seasonal night openings, which sell out quickly.

title: Make it special
description: Book a private guide to explain court life and continue on foot to neighbouring Bukchon and the Secret Garden of Changdeokgung.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Incheon International (ICN), then take the AREX train to Seoul Station, about 45 minutes, and continue by taxi or subway to Anguk station on Line 3. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Wear comfortable shoes for steep, stepped lanes. Speak softly, do not enter private doorways and respect the visiting hours posted at the neighbourhood entrances.

title: Best time to visit
description: Spring and autumn are the most pleasant, with mild weather and clear light. Visit mid-morning on a weekday, when lanes are quietest, and combine it with Gyeongbokgung the same day.

title: Make it special
description: Take a private tea ceremony or a craft class, such as knot-making or natural dyeing, in one of the traditional workshops.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Jeju International (CJU), about an hour from Seoul Gimpo (GMP) on one of the world's busiest air routes. Hiring a car or driver is the easiest way to get around the island. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: The Hallasan summit trails require an advance online reservation; book early and bring layers, as the summit is far colder than the coast. Carry a rain jacket, as the weather turns quickly.

title: Best time to visit
description: April to May brings canola flowers and cherry blossom, and September to November clear skies and autumn silver grass. July and August are hot and busy, with typhoons possible. Climb Seongsan Ilchulbong at dawn for the sunrise over the sea.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Incheon International (ICN) and take the KTX from Seoul to Singyeongju, about two to 2.5 hours. Gimhae International (PUS) near Busan is about an hour by car. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Cover shoulders and knees for the temples. Wear comfortable shoes; the sites are spread out, so a car or bicycle helps. Seokguram involves a short uphill walk from the car park.

title: Best time to visit
description: Early April brings cherry blossom around Bomun Lake, and late October to early November deep autumn colour at Bulguksa. Visit Bulguksa in the morning and Wolji Pond after dark.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Singapore Changi (SIN), about 20 minutes by taxi. Bayfront MRT station is a short walk from the gardens. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Book conservatory tickets online in advance, particularly at weekends. Wear light clothes and carry an umbrella for sudden showers; bring a light layer for the cool Cloud Forest.

title: Best time to visit
description: Singapore is warm all year. February to April tends to be drier, while November to January is the wettest period. Visit the conservatories in the afternoon heat, then stay for the evening light show at the Supertrees.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Singapore Changi (SIN), about 20 to 25 minutes by taxi. Bayfront, Marina Bay and Raffles Place MRT stations all serve the waterfront. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Wear light clothing and carry water and an umbrella. Book the SkyPark observation deck or rooftop restaurants ahead for sunset slots.

title: Best time to visit
description: Visit year-round; February to April is usually drier. The late afternoon walk into sunset and the evening shows is the best time. The Formula One night race and the National Day celebrations in August bring the bay to life, and big crowds.

title: Make it special
description: Book a sunset table at a rooftop restaurant overlooking the bay, or a private bumboat on the Singapore River.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Singapore Changi (SIN), about 25 to 30 minutes by car to Sentosa. From HarbourFront MRT, cross by the Sentosa Express monorail, the cable car or the walking boardwalk. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Buy theme park tickets online ahead, especially during school holidays. Bring swimwear, sun protection and light rain gear.

title: Best time to visit
description: Any time of year works, with February to April usually driest. Weekdays outside school holidays are quietest. Arrive at opening for Universal Studios, then spend the late afternoon on the beach.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Velana International (MLE) on Hulhulé island. Resort speedboats take roughly 15 to 45 minutes to reach most North Malé Atoll islands. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Visa on arrival is free for all nationalities, but you need a confirmed resort booking. Pack light clothing, reef-safe sunscreen and a rash vest. Alcohol is served only at resorts, and modest dress is expected on local islands and in Malé.

title: Best time to visit
description: December to April is the dry northeast monsoon season with calm seas and clear water. May to November brings more rain and wind, but also lower rates and the best surf. Snorkel the house reef in the morning, when the water is calm and fish are active.

title: Make it special
description: Arrange a private sandbank dinner under the stars, or charter a yacht for a day of snorkelling and a sunset dolphin cruise.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Velana International (MLE), then take a seaplane to Baa Atoll, about 35 to 45 minutes, or a domestic flight to Dharavandhoo (DRV) followed by a short boat ride. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
