description: Excursions are run through licensed operators and resorts; ask your resort to book. Be a confident snorkeller, wear a rash vest and fins, and follow ranger instructions to keep your distance from the mantas.

title: Best time to visit
description: The season runs roughly from June to November, with the busiest feeding often between July and October, especially around the new and full moons. Sightings depend on tides and plankton, so allow several days in the atoll.

title: Good to know
description: Choose a resort with a marine biologist on staff; they follow conditions closely and often call guests out at short notice when the mantas arrive.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Velana International (MLE), then take a seaplane to South Ari, about 25 to 35 minutes, or a domestic flight to Maamigili (VAM) and a short boat transfer. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Book with a licensed operator or through your resort. Bring a rash vest, reef-safe sunscreen and good fins; the sharks can move faster than they appear. Keep to the code of conduct and stay behind the guide.

title: Best time to visit
description: Whale sharks are present all year. December to April usually brings calmer seas and clearer water. Morning trips tend to have better conditions and fewer boats.

title: Make it special
description: End the day with a private dinner at Ithaa, the undersea restaurant, surrounded by reef fish behind curved acrylic.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Bandaranaike International (CMB) near Colombo. The drive to Sigiriya takes about four to five hours by car. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Expect around 1,200 steps, some on exposed metal stairways, so wear shoes with grip and carry water. Dress modestly and keep noise low near the upper sections, where wild hornets nest.

title: Best time to visit
description: January to April is usually the driest period in the Cultural Triangle. Start at opening time to climb before the heat and crowds build. For a sunrise view of Sigiriya itself, climb neighbouring Pidurangala rock at dawn.

title: Make it special
description: Take a hot-air balloon flight over the Cultural Triangle at dawn in season, or a private guide who can explain the frescoes and water gardens.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Bandaranaike International (CMB). Kandy is about three hours by car, or around three hours by train from Colombo Fort. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Wear white or light clothing covering shoulders and knees. Remove shoes and hats before entering, and do not turn your back to Buddha images for photos. Socks help on hot stone floors.

title: Best time to visit
description: January to April is generally drier in the hills. Attend the evening puja for the drumming and ceremony. The Esala Perahera in July or August is extraordinary, but book seats and hotels months ahead.

title: Make it special
description: Continue to the Royal Botanic Gardens at Peradeniya with a private guide, or book a reserved balcony seat for the Perahera.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Bandaranaike International (CMB). Board the hill-country train at Kandy, about three hours from the airport by car, or drive directly to Ella in about six hours. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Reserved seats sell out weeks ahead, so book early or arrange tickets through your travel planner. Pack a warm layer for the hills and shoes for muddy hiking trails.

title: Best time to visit
description: January to March is usually the clearest and driest period in the hill country. Take a morning train for the best light on the tea estates. Visit Nine Arches early, before the crowds, and check the train times to watch one cross.

title: Make it special
description: Stay a night on a working tea estate bungalow along the way, with a private tea tasting and walks among the pickers.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Bandaranaike International (CMB). The Southern Expressway brings you to Galle in about two to 2.5 hours by car. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Wear light clothing, a hat and comfortable shoes for the ramparts. Dress modestly when visiting churches, mosques and temples.

title: Best time to visit
description: December to April is the dry season on the southwest coast, with calm seas. Walk the ramparts early in the morning or at sunset. The Galle Literary Festival, usually in January, brings writers and events to the fort.

title: Make it special
description: Book a tuk-tuk tour with a local historian, then lunch at a beach villa on the coast east of the fort.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Tbilisi International Airport (TBS); the old town is about 30 minutes by car. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Pakistani passport holders can generally apply for a Georgian e-visa in advance; check the current e-visa rules before booking. Wear comfortable shoes for steep cobbles, and bring swimwear only if you prefer it in a private bath room. Carry a scarf for church visits; women are expected to cover their heads.

title: Best time to visit
description: May to June and September to October bring mild weather for walking. Take the baths in the early evening, then walk up to Narikala for sunset views over the city.

title: Make it special
description: Reserve a private bath room for two, then continue to a wine bar in Sololaki with a sommelier-led tasting of qvevri wines.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Tbilisi International Airport (TBS); Mtskheta is about 30 to 40 minutes north by car. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Churches expect modest dress: women should cover their heads and wear a skirt, and men should avoid shorts. Wraps are often provided at the door. Pakistani passport holders can generally apply for a Georgian e-visa in advance; check the current e-visa rules before booking.

title: Best time to visit
description: Spring and autumn are most comfortable. Go early in the morning to reach Jvari before tour groups, and avoid Sunday morning services if you want quiet interiors.

title: Good to know
description: Svetitskhoveli is an active church. Photography during services is best avoided.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Tbilisi International Airport (TBS), then drive about three hours north on the Georgian Military Road to Stepantsminda. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Bring warm layers even in summer, sturdy shoes for the hike, and a head covering and long skirt or wrap for the church. Pakistani passport holders can generally apply for a Georgian e-visa in advance; check the current e-visa rules before booking.

title: Best time to visit
description: June to September is best, when the road is reliably open and trails are clear of snow. Early morning gives the clearest views of Kazbek.

title: Good to know
description: Heavy snow can close the Jvari Pass in winter. Check road conditions before setting out.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Tbilisi International Airport (TBS) or Kutaisi International Airport (KUT). Mestia is a long drive, around eight to nine hours from Tbilisi or four to five from Kutaisi, and small domestic flights from Tbilisi run on a limited, weather-dependent schedule. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Pack layers, rain gear and proper walking boots, as weather changes quickly in the mountains. Carry cash for village guesthouses and small cafés. Pakistani passport holders can generally apply for a Georgian e-visa in advance; check the current e-visa rules before booking.

title: Best time to visit
description: July to September is best for hiking and for the rough road to Ushguli. Winter brings skiing near Mestia, but some routes can be cut off by snow.

title: Make it special
description: Hire a private driver and guide with a 4x4 for Ushguli, and walk part of the route between villages.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Tbilisi International Airport (TBS); Sighnaghi is about two hours east by car. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Arrange a driver so you can taste freely, and book estate visits ahead. Carry a head covering and modest clothing for Bodbe Monastery. Pakistani passport holders can generally apply for a Georgian e-visa in advance; check the current e-visa rules before booking.

title: Best time to visit
description: September and October bring rtveli, the grape harvest, with the liveliest cellars. Spring is green and quiet; summer afternoons can be hot in the valley.

title: Make it special
description: Book a private supra, a traditional Georgian feast, at a family winery with a tamada, the toastmaster, leading the table.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Heydar Aliyev International Airport (GYD); the old city is about 30 minutes by car. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Pakistani passport holders can generally obtain an Azerbaijani e-visa online; check the current e-visa rules before travelling. Wear comfortable shoes for stone lanes, and carry a scarf for mosque visits.

title: Best time to visit
description: April to June and September to October are most pleasant. Walk the old city in the morning, then return after dark when the walls are lit.

title: Make it special
description: Book a private guide for the Shirvanshahs' Palace, then visit a carpet dealer for an unhurried introduction to Azerbaijani weaving.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Heydar Aliyev International Airport (GYD); central Baku is about 30 minutes by car. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Pakistani passport holders can generally obtain an Azerbaijani e-visa online; check the current e-visa rules before travelling. Bring a light jacket, as Baku is known for strong winds off the sea.

title: Best time to visit
description: Spring and autumn are best for walking the boulevard. Come in the evening: stroll at sunset, then watch the towers light up after dark.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Heydar Aliyev International Airport (GYD); Gobustan is about an hour's drive south-west of Baku. The mud volcanoes are reached by local vehicles on an unpaved track from Gobustan village. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Pakistani passport holders can generally obtain an Azerbaijani e-visa online; check the current e-visa rules before travelling. Wear closed shoes you do not mind getting muddy, and bring sun protection and water, as there is little shade.

title: Best time to visit
description: Spring and autumn avoid the summer heat. Go in the morning for softer light on the carvings. After heavy rain the track to the volcanoes can be impassable.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Heydar Aliyev International Airport (GYD), then drive about five hours north-west to Sheki through the Caucasus foothills. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Pakistani passport holders can generally obtain an Azerbaijani e-visa online; check the current e-visa rules before travelling. Carry cash for workshops and the bazaar, and leave time to try piti, the local lamb stew, and Sheki halva.

title: Best time to visit
description: May to June and September to October bring mild days and green hills. Arrive at opening time to see the palace interiors before groups.

title: Make it special
description: Combine Sheki with Gabala on a private road journey, stopping at villages and craft workshops along the way.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Heydar Aliyev International Airport (GYD), then drive about three and a half to four hours north-west to Gabala. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Pakistani passport holders can generally obtain an Azerbaijani e-visa online; check the current e-visa rules before travelling. Pack layers and walking shoes, as mountain weather is cooler and wetter than Baku.

title: Best time to visit
description: June to September suits walking and the lakes; December to March brings snow for skiing at Tufandag. Early mornings are calm at Nohur Lake.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Samarkand International Airport (SKD), about 20 minutes from the Registan, or into Tashkent (TAS) and take the high-speed Afrosiyob train, about two to two and a half hours. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Book train seats well ahead in spring and autumn. Dress modestly with shoulders and knees covered, and carry a scarf for mosque interiors. Check the current e-visa rules for Uzbekistan before travelling.

title: Best time to visit
description: April to May and September to October bring mild weather. Visit in the early morning for quiet courtyards, and return at dusk when the square is lit.

title: Make it special
description: Arrange a private guide with a historian's background, and dinner on a terrace overlooking the illuminated square.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Samarkand International Airport (SKD), or take the Afrosiyob train from Tashkent (TAS), about two to two and a half hours. The site is a short drive from the Registan. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: This is a pilgrimage site, so dress modestly and keep voices low. Women should carry a headscarf. Wear comfortable shoes for the steps.

title: Best time to visit
description: Spring and autumn are best. Arrive early in the morning, when the low sun lights the tilework and pilgrims outnumber tourists.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Bukhara International Airport (BHK), about 15 minutes from the old city, or take the Afrosiyob train from Tashkent, about four hours, or from Samarkand, about one and a half hours. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: Book trains ahead and dress modestly, with a scarf for mosques. Carry cash in local currency for the bazaars and trading domes.

title: Best time to visit
description: April to May and September to October are best; summer afternoons are very hot. Explore in the morning and evening, and rest at midday.

title: Make it special
description: Ask for a private dinner in a restored madrasa courtyard, or a visit to a master suzani embroiderer's workshop.

title: How to reach
description: Fly into Urgench International Airport (UGC), about 40 minutes by car from Khiva. Trains also connect Khiva with Bukhara and Tashkent. From Pakistan, usually one stop via Dubai, Doha, Abu Dhabi or Istanbul.

title: What to prepare
description: A combined ticket covers most monuments; buy it at the West Gate. Bring sun protection, water and modest clothing. Check the current e-visa rules for Uzbekistan before travelling.

title: Best time to visit
description: April to May and September to October bring comfortable days. Summers are very hot and winters are cold. Early morning and sunset give the best light and fewest crowds.

title: Make it special
description: Arrange a private evening walk with a local historian, ending on a rooftop terrace for dinner.
